documents.snippet: The International Symposium on Experimental Algorithms (SEA), previously known as Workshop on Experimental Algorithms (WEA), is a computer science conference in the area of algorithm engineering.
documents.title: Symposium on Experimental Algorithms

documents.snippet: Lancichinetti–Fortunato–Radicchi benchmark is an algorithm that generates benchmark networks (artificial networks that resemble real-world networks). They have a priori known communities and are used to compare different community detection methods.
documents.title: Lancichinetti–Fortunato–Radicchi benchmark

documents.snippet: Yo-Yo is a distributed algorithm aimed at minimum finding and leader election in generic connected undirected graph. Unlike Mega-Merger it has a trivial termination and cost analysis.
documents.title: Yo-yo (algorithm)

documents.snippet: Mega-merger is a distributed algorithm aimed at solving the election problem in generic connected undirected graph.
documents.title: Mega-Merger

documents.snippet: Explore Then Commit (ETC) is an algorithm for the multi-armed bandit problem focused on finding the best trade-off between exploration and exploitation.
documents.title: Explore-then-commit algorithm
